package.name: sru_nav
package.description: ROS1 (Noetic) distribution of the SRU mapless visual navigation controller (Odin1 spatial-memory sensor). Shares its entire Python implementation with the ROS2 side via sru.ros_shim (single source tree in sru/src), so both distributions execute one code path. This package only adds the catkin build, entry script and parameter-file plumbing.
